user.title: Spoolman Active Spool
user.description: What would you like to add?

printer.title: Add printer
printer.description: Adds a button to every device created by the Spoolman integration, and creates a separate device holding the active spool's data. Add the integration again for each additional printer with a different Moonraker URL.

reconfigure_printer.title: Reconfigure printer
reconfigure_printer.description: Renaming the printer also renames the buttons' technical entity_id (button.spoolman_spool_..._'name').

webhook.title: QR links (webhook)
webhook.description: Creates one shared link for setting the active spool by scanning a QR code. Every spool gets a QR-code image entity. Opening the link (scanning) changes nothing by itself - only picking a printer on the page that opens actually applies the change.

data.webhook_id: Webhook ID (part of the URL - can be edited manually)
data.base_url: Home Assistant address (leave empty to auto-detect)

reconfigure_webhook.title: Reconfigure QR links (webhook)
reconfigure_webhook.description: Changing the webhook ID or address changes the content of every QR code - old printed codes will stop working.

data.webhook_id: Webhook ID (part of the URL - can be edited manually)
data.base_url: Home Assistant address (leave empty to auto-detect)

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach Moonraker, or its [spoolman] component is not configured.
error.unknown: Unexpected error, please check the logs.
error.invalid_webhook_id: Webhook ID may only contain letters, digits, hyphens and underscores (8-64 chars).
error.webhook_id_taken: This webhook ID is already in use in Home Assistant, pick another one.
